title: BusinessCaseType Graph Read Edge S4 Verification

runtime: fresh focused fake Graph test output

invariants: AC-S4-01: The adapter generates only Graph REST v1.0 GETs for the bound site/list and selects exactly id, eTag, BusinessCaseTypeId, LifecycleStatus, Selectable, and CatalogVersion.
AC-S4-02: Paging is complete only after a validated end; foreign hosts/bases/sites/lists, loops, invalid payloads, and page/item limit breaches never produce a valid type.
AC-S4-03: After a complete read, an identical row ETag is mapped locally to NOT_MODIFIED; different ETags return the new row. A row ETag is never misused as collection If-None-Match.
AC-S4-04: An incorrect site, list, operation, role, or runtime permission is blocked before transport; the contract allows only Sites.Selected and no schema/provisioning rights.
AC-S4-05: Graph responses are strictly typed and reduced to the registry fields; viewer, process, matter, document, and person fields do not affect type validity.
AC-S4-06: HTTP/transport errors are mapped to fixed redacted reason codes; tokens, paths, IDs, Graph bodies, and matter values appear in neither results nor exceptions/evidence.
AC-S4-07: The central CLI, domain/verification contract, standalone validator, fake Graph tests, DE/EN documentation, strict gate, and independent base...head review pass.
exit_conditions: All seven acceptance criteria from Issue #616 are represented with identical semantics in the DE/EN spec, DE/EN plan, domain contract, and verification contract.
The adapter boundary is only nac_m365_graph to the unchanged notary_kg BusinessCaseTypeRegistryReadPort.
Focused fake Graph tests prove exact GET-only selection, pre-transport scope blocking, complete fail-closed paging, local row-ETag comparison, and redaction.
The central CLI produces only a redacted offline request plan and performs zero credential loads, HTTP calls, DNS calls, or live Graph client construction.
The standalone validator, contract verification, language, link, traceability, strict-gate, and diff checks pass.
Independent base...head review has no unresolved findings and S4b writes remain excluded.
